captions.detailed: A grey street pole CCTV mast featuring a solid square concrete anchor block at the base. A tall, slightly tapered cylindrical steel pole rises from a black base collar, supporting a black clamping collar near the top. From this collar, a curved side-arm bracket extends outward, holding a black mounting yoke. The white bullet camera is attached to this yoke, allowing it to pan horizontally on a vertical revolute joint and tilt vertically on a horizontal revolute joint.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery script for a street pole CCTV mast. The model should include a square concrete base, a tall tapered steel pole, a clamping collar with a curved side arm, and a bullet camera attached to a dual-axis articulation yoke for panning and tilting.
captions.factory: Construct the base using a box primitive and the pole as a loft or tall cylinder. Create the clamping collar with a box/cylinder boolean subtraction, and model the side arm using a swept profile or curved cylinder. Build the camera yoke from small box extrusions and the camera body using a cylinder combined with a tapered cone. Define the assembly with two revolute joints: one vertical joint for panning the yoke, and one horizontal joint for tilting the camera body.
